description: This file contains a utility function named computeComfortScore that calculates a comfort score based on environmental parameters such as temperature, wind speed, humidity, air quality index, and UV index. The function provides a heuristic-based scoring mechanism for determining outdoor comfort levels.

methods.name: computeComfortScore({ temperature,  wind,  humidity,  airQuality,  uvIndex })
methods.description: Calculates a comfort score (1-10) based on the provided environmental conditions, taking into account temperature, wind, humidity, air quality, and UV index through heuristic weightings.
